steps.say: QA-CFG-024: the CPU protocol of docs/architecture/cpu-budget.md section 5 for OS-METRO: the same song twice, the metronome OFF and then ON (Cue, which plays on MAIN while OUT MODE is Stereo). `cpu reset` then `cpu perf off` (the module perf measure is not what is measured here), play 20 s, `cpu` (render max and mean, underruns), `diag bench worst` for the stage split (the click is counted in the output stage: Convert). The click sounds in 11 blocks of every beat, so the figure that moves is the MAX of the render, by the cost of one click block (the host bench has it at about 0.5 us on a PC, 64 frames, both channels; on the M4F the estimate is about 1,900 cycles, 0.7 % of a block [est: 21 instructions a frame in the disassembly of `Metro::mix`]); the mean moves by about 3 % of that, 0.02 % of a block [est]. The budget row is 0.2 %: a max that rises by more than 0.5 point of a block, or any underrun, is a finding

steps.say: QA-CFG-022/023 BY EAR, the split line out and the captures. (a) Mixer > OUT MODE to MAIN L / CUE R (the project's routing row), METRO Main: the click is on the LEFT jack only; METRO Cue: on the RIGHT jack only (the left stays silent). Then OUT MODE back to Stereo: Cue plays on both (D1). (b) The click is in NO capture: Record > RESAMPLE with the TAP on MASTER, play the song with the metronome on, record a few bars, listen to the take (PREVIEW): no click in it; with a USB host, the stems and the master stream (`usb audio` / the stems mapping) carry no click either (the host captures a few seconds: a click would show as a regular transient on Master L / R); a WAV export of a pattern has no click (OS-WAVEXP, when it lands). In the report: what was heard on each jack, and whether any capture carried the click

QA-CFG-025 COUNT-IN BY EAR (rows QA-PAT-050..055 of docs/qa/catalogue/pattern.md): Config > PATTERN > COUNT-IN 1 bar, the Pattern screen, transport stopped, Shift + Rec (LIVE with the count-in; OS-RECMODE2, Play never counts in): the strip counts RECORDING IN 4.. 3.. 2.. 1.., the pad LEDs flash on each beat (all pads, the first beat of the bar brighter), the play line waits on row 1 while it counts and nothing of the pattern plays (the click only; OS-COUNTIN), then row 1 plays and recording begins at the start point; a pad hit during the count-in sounds but writes no note; the REC frame goes red at the start. With METRO Off the count-in is silent but still counted on the strip and the pads. The Record screen with ALIGN BAR and COUNT-IN on does the same, and the take begins on the start point

steps.say: QA-CFG-037 BY HAND (the NOTES pads follow the offset; docs/qa/catalogue/config.md): set PAD OFFSET to 0 (Config > PATTERN, last row), press Pattern and Shift + F2 (NOTES; SCALE LOCK off in the held Note panel) and hit a pad of the bottom row and the pad right above it: they play the SAME note (offset 0 starts every row on the note the row below starts on). Back on Config set PAD OFFSET to 12 (Delete): the upper pad is now twelve semitones higher, the layout before the row. The change is heard at the next pad press, with no restart. Put the row back to 12 afterwards.

QA-CFG-038 BY HAND (a device setting: docs/formats/o3-settings.md, Field 22): set PAD OFFSET to 5, leave Config (the card keeps the settings once they have stayed changed), restart the unit and load any project: the row still reads 5. With the settings file of the build before the row on the card (22 settings, 214 bytes) the row reads 12 and nothing else changed. Put the row back to 12 afterwards.

QA-CFG-029 BY HAND (REC MICRO On, REC QUANTIZE Playing step so the hit stays on the step it was played in): on the Pattern screen press Play, then Shift + Rec (LIVE; OS-RECMODE2), and hit a pad (or play the keyboard) a few times at different moments of the step, then Stop and read the track of the hit in the FX 2 column. A hit played late in its step has a Micro-move (type 2) of 1..100 growing with the lateness (about half a step late is 50); one played right on the beat has no FX 2 at all (never m02 00); an FX the step already had in FX 2 is left as it was. With REC QUANTIZE Nearest step a hit in the second half of a step goes to the next step with no Micro-move (it is early for it). Replay the pattern: the late notes sound late (the sequencer reads m02 as it always did). Edit Undo takes the whole take back.

QA-CFG-030 BY HAND (REC VELOCITY External, a MIDI keyboard on the DIN or USB port): in the same take play a key soft and a key hard. The volume column of the recorded steps holds the key's velocity (1..127, the volume column's own scale); a pad hit leaves the volume column as it was; with REC VELOCITY Off the volume column of a recorded step is never changed. Set REC MICRO and REC VELOCITY back to Off afterwards (Config > PATTERN, Delete on each row).
